criteria_outcomes.criterion: observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes must support demand claims
generic keyword matches and unrelated candidates are issues
missing or contradictory evidence must remain visible

reviews.decision_reason: The selection step treats every corpus row with demand_score >= 3, plus fallback IDs, as demand-bearing even though the supplied rows contain only need text, scores, record IDs, source IDs, and source weights. Under the strict market-demand criteria, those fields do not show observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes, so the step admits unsupported demand claims into the handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: apply the explicit bounded index window
observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes must support demand claims

reviews.decision_reason: The normalization step retains only the allowed record identifiers, coerces the numeric fields, applies the explicit bounded index window, and preserves the already selected eight rows. It does not create the unsupported demand evidence; it carries forward the upstream selection.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank normalized need records by demand provenance
observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes must support demand claims

reviews.decision_reason: The provenance assembly step deterministically sorts the normalized records by descending demand_score with record_id as the tie break and emits rank, record_id, source_id, and source_weight. The final evidence_sources ordering matches the supplied upstream output, so this boundary is not the localized source of the market-demand evidence defect.
